commands.name: find-similar
commands.description:
Find similar links
Find similar links to the link provided. Optionally get contents.

options.name: --exclude-source-domain
options.description: If true, excludes links from the same domain as the provided URL from the results. Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --num-results
options.description: Number of results to return (up to thousands of results available for custom plans)

options.name: --include-domains
options.description: List of domains to include in the search. If specified, results will only come from these domains.

options.name: --exclude-domains
options.description: List of domains to exclude from search results. If specified, no results will be returned from these domains.

options.name: --start-crawl-date
options.description: Crawl date refers to the date that Exa discovered a link. Results will include links that were crawled after this date. Must be specified in ISO 8601 format.

options.name: --end-crawl-date
options.description: Crawl date refers to the date that Exa discovered a link. Results will include links that were crawled before this date. Must be specified in ISO 8601 format.

options.name: --start-published-date
options.description: Only links with a published date after this will be returned. Must be specified in ISO 8601 format.

options.name: --end-published-date
options.description: Only links with a published date before this will be returned. Must be specified in ISO 8601 format.

options.name: --include-text
options.description: List of strings that must be present in webpage text of results. Currently, only 1 string is supported, of up to 5 words.

options.name: --exclude-text
options.description: List of strings that must not be present in webpage text of results. Currently, only 1 string is supported, of up to 5 words. Checks from the first 1000 words of the webpage text.

options.name: --moderation
options.description: Enable content moderation to filter unsafe content from search results. Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --contents-livecrawl-timeout
options.description: The timeout for livecrawling in milliseconds.

options.name: --contents-max-age-hours
options.description:
Maximum age of cached content in hours. Controls when livecrawling is triggered based on content freshness.
- Positive value (e.g. 24): Use cached content if it's less than this many hours old, otherwise livecrawl.
- 0: Always livecrawl, never use cache.
- -1: Never livecrawl, always use cache.
- Omit (default): Livecrawl as fallback only when no cached content exists.

options.name: --contents-subpages
options.description: The number of subpages to crawl. The actual number crawled may be limited by system constraints.

commands.name: search
commands.description:
Search
Perform a search with a Exa prompt-engineered query and retrieve a list of relevant results. Optionally get contents.

options.name: --query
options.description: The query string for the search.

options.name: --additional-queries
options.description: Additional query variations for deep search. Only works with type="deep" or type="deep-reasoning". When provided, these queries are used alongside the main query for comprehensive results.

options.name: --type
options.description: The type of search. Neural uses an embeddings-based model, auto (default) intelligently combines neural and other search methods, fast uses streamlined versions of the search models, deep is light deep search, deep-reasoning is base deep search, and instant provides the lowest latency search optimized for real-time applications.

options.name: --category
options.description: A data category to focus on. The `people` and `company` categories have improved quality for finding LinkedIn profiles and company pages. Note: The `company` and `people` categories only support a limited set of filters. The following parameters are NOT supported for these categories: `startPublishedDate`, `endPublishedDate`, `startCrawlDate`, `endCrawlDate`, `includeText`, `excludeText`, `excludeDomains`. For `people` category, `includeDomains` only accepts LinkedIn domains. Using unsupported parameters will result in a 400 error.
